prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical Instagram cover image, 4:5 aspect ratio
Primary request: A photorealistic Japanese-style kyotei motorboat night race under bright stadium floodlights, with distant city lights softly blurred and calm dark water.
Scene/backdrop: night racing course; bright floodlights illuminate water spray, while the upper 45% remains dark, clean, and uncluttered for later title overlay.
Subject: one authentic Japanese kyotei racing boat, approximately 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer; light-colored white or pale-grey hull. It must not resemble an offshore powerboat or F1 tunnel boat. Open single-seat cockpit with absolutely no canopy, roof, or windshield bubble. A racer crouches or kneels very low inside, leaning forward, both hands on a small steering wheel. The racer wears a plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face fully hidden. One visible outboard motor at the stern creates a large white spray plume.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5, low side angle, boat running straight at full speed across the lower half, spray trailing behind; upper 45% dark negative space.
Style/medium: cinematic high-detail sports photography, realistic proportions and materials, natural motion and spray.
Lighting/mood: dramatic night stadium floodlights, restrained city bokeh, dark calm water.
Text: none.
Constraints: no recognizable real person; no extra boats; authentic open-cockpit kyotei form.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, emblems, labels, writing-like marks, canopy, roof, windshield bubble, offshore powerboat form, F1 tunnel boat form.

verification.method: visual inspection of the generated image
verification.notes: Visually inspected at full image view. The image shows one low, long, light-colored, open-cockpit kyotei racing boat running straight at speed from a low side angle at night. The racer is crouched low in a plain full-face helmet with the face hidden, and the boat has one stern outboard motor with a large white spray plume. Stadium floodlights, distant blurred city lights, calm dark water, and a dark uncluttered upper 45% are visible. No text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or recognizable real person are visible.
